ideas.name: Quarterly Expiration Opening Reversal
ideas.claim: Price reversals around the open on quarterly expiration days increased after index futures settlement moved to the open in June 1987.
ideas.quote: The results in Tables V and VI indicate that price reversals at the open on quarterly expirations increased significantly in the post-June 1987 period.
ideas.mechanism: Quarterly index derivatives expiration and settlement at the opening quotation.
ideas.claimed_result: Mean opening reversal for individual S&P 500 stocks rose from 0.061% before June 1987 to 0.281% afterward.
required_data: Intraday S&P 500 constituent stock prices around the open
